name: onetick-py-coding
description: Write, debug, and review onetick.py (otp) code against the OneTick tick database — data retrieval, aggregations, joins, orders/executions, symbols/multistage queries, bars, best-execution analytics, and OneTick SQL. Bundles the full onetick-py API reference (every function/class/method as a lookup-able markdown file), curated examples, the coding rules that prevent common mistakes, and a server-side performance-patterns catalogue (compute in OneTick, not offload-to-pandas).
